newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU barley awards included Spain, France, Finland.
newsitem.headline: EU barley awards included Spain, France, Finland.

text.p: Thursday's European Union barley export awards included 100,000 tonnes of licences granted via Spain, French cereals office ONIC said.
It said that of the total EU tonnage awarded -- 398,000 tonnes -- 162,000 had been sought through France, 100,000 through Spain and 65,000 through Finland.
Traders said much of the remaining quantity may have been taken through the Netherlands.
Spain, with large harvests, is unusually competitive this year through the main EU tender.
Traders said the top EU refund of 26.98 Ecus per tonne was worth $131-132 per tonne fob France for March.
